title: How to Ask Billy Joel a Question During His Live SiriusXM Show
summary: Fans can call Billy Joel live and submit questions by video, voice, or text ahead of the September 24 special.
body_markdown:
[Billy Joel](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/the-billy-joel-channel) is giving fans a chance to talk with him directly during his first-ever live call-in show, airing exclusively on[The Billy Joel Channel](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/the-billy-joel-channel) .


### How to Ask Billy Joel a Question


During the live show, listeners can call844-365-BILLY to speak with Billy, ask questions, and hear from him in real time.


Fans can also submit questions now by video, voice, or text at[siriusxm.com/askbilly](https://hotline.web-cloud.siriusxm.com/billy-joel?utm_campaign=SXM_Blog_BAU&utm_source=2026_09_TheBillyJoelChannel-BlogAskBilly-GeneralBAU&utm_medium=blog) .


[What would you like to ask Billy? Submit a Message Submit a Message](https://hotline.web-cloud.siriusxm.com/billy-joel?utm_campaign=SXM_Blog_BAU&utm_source=2026_09_TheBillyJoelChannel-BlogAskBilly-GeneralBAU&utm_medium=blog)


### How to Listen to Billy Joel’s Live Call-In Show


The special airs Thursday, September 24 at 2pm ET on The Billy Joel Channel (Ch. 93) and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogAskBillyJoel) .


[The Billy Joel Channel Exclusively on SiriusXM Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogAskBillyJoel)


The September 24 special marks Billy Joel’s first-ever live call-in show, exclusively on SiriusXM.


The music legend recently connected with listeners through his SiriusXM channel and shared an update on his health.


“I just want people to know, don’t worry about me, I’m not going anywhere,” Billy said. “I’m here. I’m still here.”


The Billy Joel Channel is available on Channel 93 on satellite radios and the SiriusXM app through Wednesday, September 30.


The channel features Billy Joel’s biggest hits, deep cuts, live performances, stories from throughout his career, and exclusive specialty programming, including the new *Billy Joel: Scenes From A Hit Parade* and *BJ The DJ* shows hosted by Billy himself.
